北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 19℃ 仍舒适，风力 2级 宜外出。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with a comfortable 19℃. Light breeze, good for going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪天晴，体感 15℃ 暖意足，微风很舒服哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 15℃. Gentle breeze, enjoy the warmth!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 16℃，风和日丽，心情也美美哒。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with a mild 16℃. No wind, perfect for a stroll!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 25℃ 略湿热，记得多喝水、保持清爽哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels 25℃ and humid. Stay hydrated and cool!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 21℃ 湿度高，出行记得带伞哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 21℃ with high humidity. Remember your umbrella!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州天晴，体感 16℃ 舒适，阳光正好，出去走走吧。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels 16℃. Perfect weather, enjoy the outdoors!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天晴，体感 17℃ 微风宜人，好天气别辜负啦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels 17℃ with a gentle breeze. Enjoy this lovely day!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 24℃ 挺舒适，无风，注意保湿哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels 24℃. No wind, remember to moisturize!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉天晴，体感 17℃ 但湿度高，注意防潮保持舒适。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny, feels 17℃ but very humid. Stay comfortable and dry!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 20℃ 宜人，出门注意添衣哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 20℃. Dress appropriately when heading out!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 28℃ 偏热，多喝水，防晒要做好。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 28℃ and warm. Drink plenty of water and wear sunscreen!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 4℃ 偏凉，记得多穿衣，别着凉了。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels 4℃ and chilly. Bundle up to stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 17℃ 较干，出门带好水，注意补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels 17℃ and dry. Stay hydrated when you're out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 20℃ 温和，注意温差，早晚添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels 20℃. Mind the temperature difference, dress for morning and evening.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门天晴，体感 17℃ 湿度大，出门带伞以防万一。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels 17℃ with high humidity. Take an umbrella just in case!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛天晴，体感 11℃ 略凉，出门记得添衣保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels 11℃ and cool. Remember to wear extra layers!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 11℃ 稍冷，风力 4级 较大，注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels 11℃ and a bit cold. Strong winds, so mind your hats!
